starts without this one's messages.

on the last line of your reply:

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt cap is reached, and
reaching the cap is charged the full cap. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until

# Continual-ARC notes: task-2d8b8458 (solved)

## General rule inferred from 8 demos
- Background is the dominant color. Treat non-background connected components as objects, generally using 4-neighbor connectivity.
- Find the prominent large L-shaped marker (two long perpendicular arms). Its color is the recoloring color. The corner/arms define an inside (concave) quadrant and adjacent outside quadrants.

Recolor the copy outside the L's inside angle to the L-marker color; leave the inside/template copy and all other cells unchanged. Demos consistently show a single component recolored.

## This task's confirmed solution
Grid background=4. Large marker is color 9, with vertical arm at column 18, rows 0-4, and horizontal arm at row 4, columns 18-27; its inside angle is NE. A color-5 component at rows 0-2, columns 24-27 is congruent to a color-6 component at rows 6-8, columns 24-27 (same 7-cell shape, up to translation). The latter lies outside the marker's inside angle and was changed from 6 to 9. The final correct output only changed those 7 cells (r6: c24-27; r7: c24-27; r8: c24-25) to 9.

## Evidence from demos

- D2: large 5 L; an outside 1 L-triomino recolored to 5.
- D3: large 9 L; outside vertical 5-domino recolored to 9.
